lines: No, nothing, I just wanted to talk a bit.
You know, {wave:1}I've grown to like you{/} for some reason.
I wanted to say, before you, I have brought other species to help me... sometimes with {shake:1.5}force{/}.
But you are different. There is something {#FFD700}magical, heroic{/} in you. And you also seem {i}smarter{/} than the others.
